en: Colorized vintage scene of several men in traditional Ottoman/Balkan dress in an open dusty square or yard. Two men stand in the center engaged in what appears to be a mock fight or folk dance with sticks, while others sit and watch in the foreground wearing fezzes and sashes. Simple low buildings line the background, and a child walks toward the group. The overall style and composition resemble an ethnographic or 'local life' postcard. The only visible text is a small website watermark at the bottom.
